11675-vanishing-roads-and-other-essays.title: And Other Essays
11675-vanishing-roads-and-other-essays.creator: Richard Le Gallienne
11675-vanishing-roads-and-other-essays.description: A book by Richard Le Gallienne. Though actually the work of man's hands--or, more properly speaking, the work of his travelling feet,--roads have long since come to seem so much a part of Nature that we have grown to think of them as a feature of the landscape no less natural than rocks and trees.

arxiv-2106-06641.title: Conservative Integrators for Many–body Problems
arxiv-2106-06641.creator: Andy T. S. Wan, Alexander Bihlo, Jean-Christophe Nave
arxiv-2106-06641.description: Abstract Conservative symmetric second–order one–step schemes are derived for dynamical systems describing various many–body systems using the Discrete Multiplier Method. This includes conservative schemes for the n n -species Lotka–Volterra system, the n n -body problem with radially symmetric potential and the n n -point vortex models in the plane and on the sphere.

arxiv-2111-07105.title: Isoscalar giant monopole resonance in 24 Mg and 28 Si: Effect of coupling between the isoscalar monopole and quadrupole strength
arxiv-2111-07105.creator: A. Bahini, V. O. Nesterenko, I. T. Usman, P. von Neumann-Cosel, R. Neveling, J. Carter, J. Kvasil, A. Repko, P. Adsley, N. Botha, J. W. Brummer, L. M. Donaldson, S. Jongile, T. C. Khumalo, M. B. Latif, K. C. W. Li, P. Z. Mabika, P. T. Molema, C. S. Moodley, S. D. Olorunfunmi, P. Papka, L. Pellegri,
arxiv-2111-07105.description: Abstract Background: In highly deformed nuclei, there is a noticeable coupling of the Isoscalar Giant Monopole Resonance (ISGMR) and the K = 0 K=0 component of the Isoscalar Giant Quadrupole Resonance (ISGQR), which results in a double peak structure of the isoscalar monopole (IS0) strength (a narrow low-energy deformation-induced peak and a main broad ISGMR part).

arxiv-2201-11014.title: Language-biased image classification: evaluation based on semantic representations
arxiv-2201-11014.creator: Yoann Lemesle, Masataka Sawayama, Guillermo Valle-Perez, Maxime Adolphe, Hélène Sauzéon, Pierre-Yves Oudeyer
arxiv-2201-11014.description: Abstract Humans show language-biased image recognition for a word-embedded image, known as picture-word interference. Such interference depends on hierarchical semantic categories and reflects that human language processing highly interacts with visual processing. Similar to humans, recent artificial models jointly trained on texts and images, e.g., OpenAI CLIP, show language-biased image classification.

arxiv-2205-13962.title: Improved Constraints on Cosmic Birefringence from the WMAP and Planck Cosmic Microwave Background Polarization Data
arxiv-2205-13962.creator: Johannes R. Eskilt, Eiichiro Komatsu
arxiv-2205-13962.description: Abstract The observed pattern of linear polarization of the cosmic microwave background (CMB) photons is a sensitive probe of physics violating parity symmetry under inversion of spatial coordinates. A new parity-violating interaction might have rotated the plane of linear polarization by an angle β \beta as the CMB photons have been traveling for more than 13 billion years.

arxiv-2402-00156.title: Erie: A Declarative Grammar for Data Sonification Conference: Proceedings of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; May 11–16, 2024; Honolulu, HI, USA Proceedings of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI ’24), May 11–16, 2024, Honolulu, HI, USA DOI: 10.1145
arxiv-2402-00156.creator: Hyeok Kim, Yea-Seul Kim, Jessica Hullman
arxiv-2402-00156.description: Abstract . Data sonification—mapping data variables to auditory variables, such as pitch or volume—is used for data accessibility, scientific exploration, and data-driven art (e.g., museum exhibitions) among others. While a substantial amount of research has been made on effective and intuitive sonification design, software support is not commensurate, limiting researchers from fully exploring its capabilities.

arxiv-2509-18407.title: Assistive Decision-Making for Right of Way Navigation at Uncontrolled Intersections
arxiv-2509-18407.creator: Navya Tiwari, Joseph Vazhaeparampil, Victoria Preston
arxiv-2509-18407.description: Abstract I INTRODUCTION Intersections account for nearly 40% of U.S. crashes [ 1 ] , with many occurring at uncontrolled or partially controlled locations [ 2 ] . Ambiguous right of way, compounded by occlusions, non-compliant drivers, and limited sensing leave drivers uncertain how to act [ 3 ] .

arxiv-2602-12207.title: VIRENA Virtual Arena for Research, Education, and Democratic Innovation VIRENA is under active development and currently in use at the University of Zurich, partly supported by the DIZH Innovation Program: 2nd Founder-Call. This preprint will be updated as new features are released. For the latest v
arxiv-2602-12207.creator: Emma Hoes, K. Jonathan Klüser, Fabrizio Gilardi
arxiv-2602-12207.description: Abstract Digital platforms shape how people communicate, deliberate, and form opinions. Studying these dynamics has become increasingly difficult due to restricted data access, ethical constraints on real-world experiments, and limitations of existing research tools. VIRENA (Virtual Arena) is a platform that enables controlled experimentation in realistic social media environments.

arxiv-2602-23683.title: Transition of Magnetic Reconnection Regimes in Partially Ionized Plasmas
arxiv-2602-23683.creator: Liang Wang, Chuanfei Dong, Yi-Min Huang, Yue Yuan, Xinmin Li, Yang Zhang
arxiv-2602-23683.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Liang Wang, Chuanfei Dong, Yi-Min Huang, Yue Yuan, Xinmin Li, Yang Zhang. Magnetic reconnection in partially ionized plasmas plays a crucial role in a wide range of solar, astrophysical, and laboratory environments. While reconnection in such plasmas is commonly characterized by the ion-neutral coupling strength and the ionization fraction χ = n i / ( n i + n n ) \chi=n_{i}/(n_{i}+n_{n}) , most previous studies have focused primarily on the former.

petit-albert-1782.title: Le Petit Albert (1782)
petit-albert-1782.creator: Anonymous
petit-albert-1782.description: The 'Little Albert' — the beloved French book of natural and cabalistic magic, secrets, and recipes; the most widely circulated French grimoire chapbook.

pmc-10742885.title: Heart Rate Variability Measurement through a Smart Wearable Device: Another Breakthrough for Personal Health Monitoring?
pmc-10742885.creator: Ke Li, Cristiano Cardoso, Angel Moctezuma-Ramirez, Abdelmotagaly Elgalad, Emerson Perin, George Crooks
pmc-10742885.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Heart rate variability (HRV) is a measurement of the fluctuation of time between each heartbeat and reflects the function of the autonomic nervous system. HRV is an important indicator for both physical and mental status and for broad-scope diseases. In this review, we discuss how wearable devices can be used to monitor HRV, and we compare the HRV monitoring function among different devices.

pmc-11709896.title: Molecular and functional analysis using Presenilin‐1 G206A mutation iPSC lines to understand age‐of‐onset variability in autosomal dominant Alzheimer disease
pmc-11709896.creator: Katrina Celis
pmc-11709896.description: BackgroundPathogenic variants in Presenilin‐1 (PSEN1) cause autosomal dominant forms of early‐onset Alzheimer disease (AD). Despite the high penetrance, substantial interindividual variability in age‐of‐onset (AOO) is observed among different PSEN1 mutations. Attempting to understand the molecular mechanisms leading to variability in AOO in PSEN1 mutations, we focused on three mutations located at codon 206 (G206A, G206S and G206D) of this gene.

pmc-11826010.title: Review of 2022 PSOGI/RENAPE Consensus on HIPEC
pmc-11826010.creator: Shigeki Kusamura, Aditi Bhatt, Kurt van Der Speeten, Vahan Kepenekian, Martin Hübner, Clarisse Eveno, Ignace de Hingh, Jean‐Baptiste Delhorme, Abdelkader Taibi, Laurent Villeneuve, Rea Lo Dico, Brendan Moran, Kim Govaerts, Oliver Zivanovic, Donal Brennan, Cedric Nadeau, Willemien Van Driel, Naoual B
pmc-11826010.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The 2022 PSOGI (Peritoneal Surface Oncology Group International) and RENAPE (French Network for Rare Peritoneal Malignancies) consensus on hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (HIPEC) was a comprehensive effort aimed at standardizing treatment protocols for various peritoneal malignancies.

pmc-12362940.title: Association between dietary inflammatory index and hepatic steatosis: cross-sectional evidence from the NHANES 2007–2020
pmc-12362940.creator: Zhounan Wu, Yuhang Liang, Li Zeng, Jiayi Fang, Jinshen He
pmc-12362940.description: BackgroundAlthough inflammation and dietary habits have been linked to obesity-associated hepatic steatosis, the role of diet-mediated inflammation in the course of hepatic steatosis remains unclear. This study aims to investigate the association between the Dietary Inflammatory Index (DII) and hepatic steatosis in the US population.

pmc-12557865.title: From childhood shadows to adult aches: a prospective cohort study on adverse childhood experiences, depressive symptoms, and incident arthritis in middle-aged and older Chinese adults
pmc-12557865.creator: Bo-wen Lu, Jia-cheng Li, Ming-tao Wen, Yu-qi Guo, Gang Li
pmc-12557865.description: ObjectivesThis study investigates the impact of adverse childhood experiences (ACEs) and depressive symptoms on incident arthritis in middle-aged and older Chinese adults, examining the mediating role of depressive symptoms in the ACEs–arthritis relationship to uncover psychological mechanisms underlying arthritis development.

pmc-12565640.title: Surgical Management of Sacroiliac Joint Dislocations and Crescent Fractures: A Nine-Year Clinical Follow-Up
pmc-12565640.creator: Hüseyin Utku Özdeş, Muhammed Köroğlu, İdris Çoban, Ahmet Harma, Okan Aslantürk
pmc-12565640.description: Background: Pelvic injuries of the sacroiliac joint are unstable and require surgical intervention following high-energy trauma. In this study, we aimed to present the long-term clinical outcomes of patients with sacroiliac joint separation and sacroiliac fracture dislocation (crescent) injury. We compared the surgical interventions performed on the sacroiliac joint based on patient clinical data.

pmc-12844196.title: A Bidirectional Design Method for Through-Glass Vias with Selective Laser Wet Etching Based on the Cross-Modal Learning Method
pmc-12844196.creator: Yongbo Meng, Liqing Wu, Bo Yuan, Xingping Zhou, Yan Li, Zhijun Zhang, Yuechun Shi
pmc-12844196.description: As an interposer, Through-Glass Vias (TGVs) play a critical role in advanced packaging such as Co-packaged optics (CPO). Currently, due to the complex influence of laser wet-etching process parameters, the precise bidirectional prediction of TGV parameters and the etching morphology still remains a challenge.

pmc-12954345.title: Haploidentical Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation With Anti‐Thymocyte Globulin in the Treatment of Older Adults With Hematological Malignancy
pmc-12954345.creator: Xin Kong, Jingjing Han, Yin Liu, Baoquan Song, Xiaowen Tang, Shengli Xue, Miao Miao, Yue Han, Ying Wang, Suning Chen, Aining Sun, Mingming Hu, Jun Chen, Feng Chen, Jian Zhang, Hui‐Ying Qiu, Depei Wu
pmc-12954345.description: ObjectivesStudies on the efficacy and safety of haploidentical hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (haplo‐SCT) with anti‐thymocyte globulin (ATG) in patients aged ≥ 60 years remain limited.MethodsWe performed a study presenting data from 54 patients aged ≥ 60 years with hematologic malignancies who underwent haplo‐SCT with ATG.ResultsThe median follow‐up was 15 months.

pmc-13005558.title: Effects of post-match foam rolling, static stretching, and passive rest on acute cardiac-autonomic, hemodynamic, and neuromuscular recovery in national wrestlers
pmc-13005558.creator: Ali Kamil Güngör, Hüseyin Topçu, Yahya Yildirim, Andrew Flatt
pmc-13005558.description: Practical strategies that facilitate rapid restoration of cardiovascular and neuromuscular function are needed to support the short recovery window between matches in high-level wrestling tournaments. This study compared the effects of post-match foam rolling (FR), static stretching (SS), and passive rest (PR) on cardiac-autonomic, hemodynamic, and neuromuscular performance markers in national-level wrestlers.

pmc-13281897.title: cGAMP-Loaded M2e Nanovaccine Elicits Cross-Reactive Immunity and Mitigates H6N1 Avian Influenza Infection in Chickens
pmc-13281897.creator: Li-Yuan Chen, Hsiao-Han Tsai, Lu Peng, Bing-Yu Yao, Jimmy Chiu, Che-Ming Jack Hu, Hui-Wen Chen

pmc-13337705.creator: Müzeyyen Soyer, Seçil Ömür Sünbül

pmc-13473555.title: The predictive value of systemic inflammation response index and albumin-to-globulin ratio for prognosis in non-small cell lung cancer
pmc-13473555.creator: Qiuping Xu, Yinyin Deng, Yuping Cai, Shaobin Yu, Mingqiang Kang, Fei He
pmc-13473555.description: We investigated whether inflammatory markers would be significant prognostic factors for survival in patients with non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC). This was a retrospective cohort study including 748 consecutive Chinese NSCLC patients. The relationships of inflammatory markers with clinicopathologic characteristics and prognosis were analyzed by chi-squared test and Cox regression.

pmc-13654154.title: A wavelet-enhanced state space model for multi-disease diagnosis across chest X-ray, CT, and MRI
pmc-13654154.creator: Yuting Xue, Lihua Liu, Chao Zheng, Tao Zhou, Kexin Zhang
pmc-13654154.description: BackgroundMedical image classification faces multiple challenges, including heterogeneous lesion morphology, cross-modal representation discrepancy, and computational efficiency. Traditional convolutional neural networks (CNNs) struggle to model long-range semantic correlations due to their fixed receptive fields, while the quadratic complexity of Transformers hinders the practical processing of high-resolution images.
